gramlot-py-server 0.2.1 is the first release of the Python server adapters for Gramlot. It gathers in one package the adapters that lived in gramlot-uvicorn, gramlot-django, gramlot-flask, gramlot-fastapi and gramlot-kajenn, none of which was published. Its version follows the Gramlot core, and it requires `gramlot>=0.2.1`.

## Install

One extra per framework:

```sh
python -m pip install "gramlot-py-server[uvicorn]"   # or [django], [flask], [fastapi], [kajenn]
```

## Modules and names

| Module | Names |
|---|---|
| `gramlot_py_server.uvicorn` | `Application`, `create_application(pages, **options)` |
| `gramlot_py_server.django` | `Pages` (include `pages.urls` in a URLconf) |
| `gramlot_py_server.flask` | `Pages`, `mount_pages(app, pages, **options)` |
| `gramlot_py_server.fastapi` | `Pages`, `mount_pages(app, pages, **options)`, `Application` |
| `gramlot_py_server.kajenn` | `Application` (declare it with `request(body="raw")`) |

## What every adapter does

- Serves the pages of one folder through the core `FileHost` of gramlot 0.2.1.
- Passes its mount path to `open_page`, so browser URLs carry the mount prefix once: `mount_path` for Uvicorn, Django, Flask and FastAPI, the application `mount` for Kajenn.
- Serves with GET and HEAD the `.css` and `_aux.js` files below the pages folder: the page companions and `Page.css` files.
- Sends the application's `content_security_policy`, with `{nonce}` replaced by the nonce of the bootstrap script.

Each framework has a quick start example in `examples/<framework>/`, tested in CI.

## Upgrading from the unpublished adapters

| Before | Now |
|---|---|
| `gramlot_uvicorn.NativeHtmlASGI` | `gramlot_py_server.uvicorn.Application` |
| `gramlot_uvicorn.create_asgi_application` | `gramlot_py_server.uvicorn.create_application` |
| `gramlot_django.NativeHtmlPages` | `gramlot_py_server.django.Pages` |
| `gramlot_flask.NativeHtmlPages`, `mount_native_html` | `gramlot_py_server.flask.Pages`, `mount_pages` |
| `gramlot_fastapi.NativeHtmlPages`, `NativeHtmlApplication`, `mount_native_html` | `gramlot_py_server.fastapi.Pages`, `Application`, `mount_pages` |
| `gramlot_kajenn.KajennNativeHtmlApplication` | `gramlot_py_server.kajenn.Application` |
| `prefix=` (Django, Flask, FastAPI) | `mount_path=` |

The old names have no aliases. Parts that depend on a database are left to the next release.
